hook: A 5-tonne skid-steer loader learned in simulation to balance on two wheels and drive on rough ground.
summary: Heavy hydraulic machines are hard to automate and dangerous to test. Reinforcement learning trained entirely in simulation transferred to a John Deere 332G, which autonomously tipped onto two wheels, drove, spun and swung its bucket before landing. It was one machine and a set of maneuvers, so general reliability across machines and sites is unknown.
title: Heavy metal acrobatics: Learning dynamic control for skid-steer loaders.
